title: v8 — 4 days: Mon · Tue · Thu · Fri
rules: Main lifts: 5/3/1 off the Training Max (tm). Weights are computed and rounded DOWN to 2.5 kg. Clean top set, no AMRAP.
Speed intent: every concentric rep as FAST as possible, warm-ups included. A rep that visibly slows ends the set — power work is never done tired.
Arms (curls / triceps): LIGHT. 2 sets, stop 3+ reps before failure — pump, not grind.
Evening (2nd part of the day): pullups / chin-ups only. 2 min warm-up (arm swings, scap pulls, dead hang), every rep chest to bar, stop 3+ reps in reserve. Never to failure.
Rest: main sets 2–3 min · secondary barbell 2 min · accessories 60–90 s · supersets (⇄) 60–75 s per pair.
Every lift day ends with 15 min easy stair stepper (zone 2).
Next cycle: week-3 targets clean → smallest jump (dumbbell +2 kg, barbell/cable +2.5 kg), TMs +5 squat/deadlift, +2.5 bench.
